title: Boundary candidate resets while the saved answer survives
steps: Set Candidate stop to a value other than 3, wait for the draft to save, refresh, then Resume diagnostic.
observed: The restored answer is retained, but the dial, slider and numeric candidate reset to 3. The screenshot shows a saved answer of 5 alongside a candidate of 3.
impact: The learner sees conflicting states; touching the reset control can overwrite the restored answer.
recommendation: Initialize/synchronize the candidate from the restored draft and keep a single source of answer state.

title: Source-line choice loses its selected state on resume
steps: Select a source-line radio, wait for its answer draft to save, refresh and Resume diagnostic.
observed: The text answer is restored, but no source-line radio remains checked.
impact: The visible error-localization control no longer represents the saved answer.
recommendation: Derive the selected line from the saved draft, including updates made through the answer input.

title: State-card scratch work is not restored
steps: Advance through state cards, enter scratch predictions, save the final answer, refresh and Resume diagnostic.
observed: The answer persists, but transition notes and active state-card position reset.
impact: Exploration work can disappear during a break even though the answer draft is saved. Scratch work is not graded.
recommendation: Persist per-transition scratch state separately, or disclose clearly that the thinking-space notes are temporary.

title: The return-contract lesson still uses generic verification practice
affected: Functions & scope lesson reached from the struggling report
steps: Open the Functions module recommendation for return-contract; predict a case, compare the example, and exercise both practice options.
observed: The route displays Practice: return-contract, but its guided check falls through to the generic independent-expectation question instead of a return-value contract exercise. Both buttons work; all six modules are reachable.
impact: The recommendation is functional, but its repair activity is less targeted than the diagnostic subskill suggests.
recommendation: Give return-contract an explicit guided activity and review the other generic fallback routes for subskill alignment.

title: Localized code displays two sets of line numbers
steps: Inspect an error-location question before submitting.
observed: The code already contains authored 1:, 2: labels while the renderer adds its own gutter numbers. This was visually observed, not counted as a failed submission.
impact: Redundant labels add clutter to a task that asks for a line number.
recommendation: Use one consistent presentation numbering layer without mutating published bank snapshots or grading line identifiers.
